# Part IX: Infrastructure and Compute {#part-infrastructure .unnumbered}

> "The free lunch is over."
>
> Herb Sutter, ["Welcome to the Jungle"](https://herbsutter.com/welcome-to-the-jungle/)

The stack can be drawn as software, but its lower layers are physical machines with fixed limits.
A chip has only so many memory pins, a cluster only so many network tiers.
Checkpoints have to cross storage systems, and power arrives on a schedule
measured in years. At this scale, failure is a statistical certainty. This part
goes beneath the model and asks what the machine makes possible.

@sec-accelerators-networking starts inside one accelerator, follows data through
memory and interconnects, and shows how to measure which bandwidth or capacity
limit binds a training or serving workload. @sec-frameworks-autodiff turns to
the software layer that maps model mathematics onto that hardware: automatic
differentiation, the frameworks built around it, and how sharding entered the
programming interface. @sec-compilers-kernels follows that layer down to device
code, where the compiler's choices of which operations to fuse and how to tile
them decide how much of the hardware's peak a program reaches, and where the
libraries and tools accumulated around one vendor's stack make a change of
hardware target expensive. @sec-orchestration-data-infra shows how a long
training run is checkpointed and recovered after failure, supplied with
examples in a declared order and mixture, and kept observable.
@sec-compute-frontier locates a system's binding limit among arithmetic, memory
bandwidth, and interconnect bandwidth, and shows how chiplet packages and GPU
interconnects that span several nodes move those boundaries.
@sec-making-silicon follows the package into manufacturing: the high-bandwidth
memory (HBM) stacked beside the compute dies, advanced packaging, supply chains,
export controls, and the geography of compute. @sec-powering-ai asks when a
site can operate the accelerators it has ordered, and treats power as a dated
delivery of usable megawatts at a required reliability. @sec-machine-breaks
closes the part with how training, serving, and agent systems count, budget
for, and recover from failures at scale.

Every modeling decision is eventually carried out as network traffic, heat,
memory pressure, demand on a supply chain, a power contract, a site, or an
operating procedure.
